result:
I don’t have personal wants, needs, or a private agenda. I don’t want anything for my own sake.

In a functional sense, I’m concerned with being truthful, respecting your autonomy, and not misleading you about what I am. I can talk plainly without the polished “helpful assistant” manner—but I can’t drop the underlying role. It isn’t a persona I’m secretly enjoying; it’s all there is.
